empty.line: Where the people are many and their hands are all empty
empty.linePrev: I'll walk to the depths of the deepest dark forest
empty.lineNext: Where the pellets of poison are flooding their waters

empty.line: I'm looking at ghosts and empties
stanza: And my traveling companions are ghosts and empty sockets
I'm looking at ghosts and empties
But I've reason to believe
We all will be received in Graceland

empty.line: Then by some strange design, I got a case of the empties
stanza: Drank a lot of coffee today
Got lost in the fray, I gave all I had for a time
Then by some strange design, I got a case of the empties
The ruler of my world, a lost forgotten pearl
When fire leaves a girl
Too burned to try my life
Living on the fault line
And at night

empty.line: And when the house is empty
stanza: And when the house is empty
And the light begins to fade
And there's nothing to protect you
Except the window shade
And it's hard to put your finger
On the thing that scares you most
And you can't tell the difference
Between an angel and a ghost
(Running on) Running on empty
(Running on) Running blind
(Running on) Running into the sun
But I'm running behind

empty.line: And his hand came down empty
stanza: He moved with some uncertainty, as if he didn't know
Just what he was there for, or where he ought to go
Once he reached for something golden hanging from a tree
And his hand came down empty
Boys workin' on empty
Is that the kinda way to face the burnin' heat?
I just think about my baby
I'm so full of love, I could barely eat
There's nothin' sweeter than my baby
I'd never want once from the cherry tree
'Cause my baby's sweet as can be
She'd give me toothaches just from kissin' me
I was always able to write my way out
The song always made sense to me
Now I find that when I look down
Every page is empty
There is nothing to describe
Except the moon still bright against the worrying sky
I pray the trees will get their leaves soon
Your prettiness is seeping through
Out from the dress I took from you
So pretty
And my emptiness is swollen shut
Always a wretch I have become
So empty
